name: MGS Seguros
verdict: Unlisted Spanish insurer: no organised-market shares, largest named stake is the Fundación Mutua General de Seguros at 19.01%, no state body or fund in the chain. Nothing found.
note: MGS, Seguros y Reaseguros S.A. (Madrid). Sleeve sponsor of Racing Santander for 2026/27 per Score and Change; also sleeve sponsor of Málaga and Elche. The Fundación Mutua General de Seguros is a private foundation linked to the company, not a state body.
